products.name: Peasy Comparison Platform (peasy.be)
products.description: peasy.be is the single consumer front door that Peasy placed in front of the hypotheek.winkel, Verzekeringen.be and Aanbieders.be brands in early 2025: mortgage simulators (how much can I borrow, feasibility check, notary costs, refinancing), insurance comparison for car, fire, funeral and outstanding-balance cover, electricity and gas comparison including meter type and solar panels, telecom and mobile comparison, the budget barometer, upload-your-proposal, appointment booking in an office or by video call, callback requests and blog and FAQ content, in Dutch and French. Its promise is 'besparen zonder gedoe': comparing is free because the chosen partner pays a referral fee, and Peasy never becomes the contracting party.

primaryCustomers.name: First-time Home Buyer
primaryCustomers.description: Starts with a simulator, learns what the household can borrow and books an expert appointment without visiting a single bank.

primaryCustomers.name: Household Fixed-Cost Saver
primaryCustomers.description: Compares insurance, energy and telecom in one place, in Dutch or French, and lets Peasy do the switch.

products.name: hypotheek.winkel Mortgage Advice
products.description: The mortgage brokerage that started in 2001 and today runs about 70 franchised hypotheek.winkel offices across Flanders and Brussels. A hypotheek.expert maps the buyer's situation and project, compares the daily conditions of 25 banks on one screen, recommends the best total package, assembles the credit file, submits it to the chosen bank, follows approval through compromis and notary deed and attaches outstanding-balance and fire insurance. The service is free for the buyer because the bank pays a referral commission on each concluded loan; it also covers refinancing, renovation loans, second homes, new builds and borrowing as a self-employed person.

primaryCustomers.name: First-time Home Buyer
primaryCustomers.description: Gets the best total mortgage package from 25 banks and a guided path from accepted offer to notary deed, free of charge.

primaryCustomers.name: Refinancing and Second-Project Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Has a refinancing, renovation, second-home or new-build case compared and filed by an expert who knows what banks accept.

products.name: Feasibility Certificate (Haalbaarheidscertificaat)
products.description: The haalbaarheidscertificaat that a first-time buyer shows to sellers and estate agents to prove borrowing capacity before making an offer. After an online feasibility check or an office appointment, the expert compares salary and savings against the conditions of 25 banks, accounts for notary costs and for the Flemish renovation obligation on low-EPC homes, and issues a certificate stating what the household can responsibly borrow. It turns the simulator into a credible negotiating document, brings buyers into the office network early and gives sellers confidence that the financing will close.

primaryCustomers.name: First-time Home Buyer
primaryCustomers.description: Proves to sellers how much the household can borrow and makes an offer with confidence.

products.name: Upload-Your-Proposal Review
products.description: A free second opinion on a mortgage or insurance proposal a household received from its own bank or another intermediary. The customer uploads the proposal on peasy.be or hypotheekwinkel.be, a hypotheek.winkel expert compares it with the daily conditions of 25 banks or the offers of 11 insurers, and returns a quick verdict on whether it can be beaten and by how much. The review is the main entry point for refinancing and for price-sensitive owners who want a one-page comparison before deciding, and it converts into a full brokerage file when a better package exists.

primaryCustomers.name: Refinancing and Second-Project Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Finds out fast whether the proposal from the own bank or the current loan can be beaten.

primaryCustomers.name: First-time Home Buyer
primaryCustomers.description: Checks the offer a bank already made before signing, without a second round of bank visits.

products.name: Verzekeringen.be Insurance Comparison
products.type: Insurance Comparison and Brokerage (Web + Customer Care)
products.description: Verzekeringen.be / Assurances.be, acquired in 2021, compares car, fire, funeral, outstanding-balance and other household insurance across 11 insurers and lets customer-care advisors quote and bind the chosen policy by phone, chat or callback, including cancellation of the old contract. For mortgage customers it supplies the outstanding-balance and fire cover that banks require at closing; for fixed-cost savers it is the insurance leg of the household relationship. The service is free because insurers pay a referral fee, and Peasy stays independent because the policy is always concluded with the insurer.

primaryCustomers.name: Household Fixed-Cost Saver
primaryCustomers.description: Switches car, fire, funeral or outstanding-balance insurance to a cheaper insurer without doing the paperwork.

primaryCustomers.name: Refinancing and Second-Project Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps the loan-linked outstanding-balance and fire insurance optimal after a refinancing or extension.

products.name: Aanbieders.be Energy and Telecom Switching
products.type: Energy and Telecom Comparison and Switching (Web + Customer Care)
products.description: Aanbieders.be / Mesfournisseurs.be, acquired in 2022, compares electricity and gas contracts (meter type, digital meter, solar panels and the prosumer tariff), internet, TV and telephony packs and mobile plans, and executes the switch to the new supplier or operator free of charge, using BIPT Easy Switch so the new fixed operator terminates the old contract. Advisors in Hasselt and Oujda handle the switch by phone or chat when the household prefers not to self-serve. Rated 4.6 on Google with 2,765 reviews, it is a high-frequency entry point into the Peasy household relationship.

primaryCustomers.name: Household Fixed-Cost Saver
primaryCustomers.description: Compares and switches electricity, gas, internet, TV and mobile in minutes and lets Peasy terminate the old contracts.

products.name: Budget Barometer
products.description: The budgetbarometer on peasy.be benchmarks a household's recurring fixed costs, such as mortgage, insurance, energy, internet, TV and mobile, against Belgian averages for a comparable household and shows where the family overpays. Each line that scores above average links straight into the matching comparison module and, when the household chooses, into a monitored contract in its Peasy account. It is the diagnostic start of the fixed-cost saving journey: instead of asking people to compare everything, it tells them which contract to compare first and how much a switch could be worth.

primaryCustomers.name: Household Fixed-Cost Saver
primaryCustomers.description: Sees in one screen where the household overpays compared with Belgian averages and which contract to switch first.

products.name: Contract Monitoring Service
products.description: Once a contract has been brokered, Peasy keeps an eye on it: policies, energy and telecom contracts and loan-linked insurance are stored per household in the contract vault, renewal dates and tariff changes are monitored, and the household is warned when a better or cheaper option exists, with the small print handled by an advisor. Refinancers get a watch on their loan-linked insurance after the change. The service is the cross-sell engine that turns one mortgage into a lasting household relationship and the basis of the three-year goal of a monitored contract vault per household.

primaryCustomers.name: Household Fixed-Cost Saver
primaryCustomers.description: Has someone watch every brokered contract and warn when a better deal exists, then switch with one confirmation.

primaryCustomers.name: Refinancing and Second-Project Owner
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps outstanding-balance and fire insurance aligned with the loan after refinancing without re-comparing manually.

products.name: Expert Workbench
products.description: The internal workbench used by the roughly 150 hypotheek.experts in about 70 offices: the daily bank rate and conditions feed of 25 banks, the multi-bank proposal comparison engine that compares packages on one screen, the FSMA-compliant advice record and suitability assessment, credit file and document collection, bank submission and approval tracking, closing, notary and disbursement tracking, refinancing and renovation cases, and insurance attach. It is where an appointment becomes a bank-ready file and where files completed per expert and file first-time-complete rate are measured; franchisees see the same pipeline for their offices.

primaryCustomers.name: Mortgage Expert
primaryCustomers.description: Turns every appointment into a complete, bank-ready file and advises independently across 25 banks from one screen.

primaryCustomers.name: Office Franchisee
primaryCustomers.description: Sees every file in the office pipeline, from appointment to notary deed, and where it is stuck.

products.name: Customer-Care Desk
products.description: The omnichannel desk used by customer-care advisors in Hasselt and Oujda for insurance, energy and telecom requests: a ticketing inbox that unifies phone, chat, callback and e-mail contacts, the comparison modules and advisor scripts, insurance quoting and policy binding across 11 insurers, energy and telecom switch execution, cancellation of old contracts, and the follow-up of monitoring alerts. It is built for first-contact resolution and error-free switches, with the knowledge base and script library keeping advice consistent across two sites, two languages and the three consumer brands.

primaryCustomers.name: Customer-Care Advisor
primaryCustomers.description: Resolves a comparison request in one contact and executes switches and cancellations without errors.

products.name: Franchise and Academy Programme
products.description: The programme through which head office in Zaventem grows and runs the office network: franchise onboarding and office management, lead routing to the nearest office, production, conversion and commission dashboards per office and per expert, local marketing support, and the Peasy academy that recruits career changers and trains and certifies about 30 mortgage experts and insurance advisors per year to meet FSMA knowledge requirements. Because the mortgage expert is a scarce-skill role the market cannot supply, the academy is how advisor capacity becomes a planned number rather than a bottleneck as the network grows to 81 offices with Meilleurtaux.

primaryCustomers.name: Office Franchisee
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps the office fed with qualified appointments, recruits and trains experts and sees production, conversion and commissions clearly.

primaryCustomers.name: Mortgage Expert
primaryCustomers.description: Is trained and certified in-house and sees own production and conversion against the office and the network.

primaryCustomers.name: Network and Compliance Operations Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Onboards and certifies about 30 advisors a year and runs the network from one set of dashboards.

products.name: Partner Portal and Commissions
products.description: The partner-facing side of the business model: a portal where the more than 50 partners (the 25 banks, the 11 insurers and the energy suppliers and telecom operators) maintain their product catalogue and tariff feeds, receive leads, credit files and switch orders, and see their conversion; and the commission engine that reconciles the referral fee each partner pays per concluded contract against the more than 50,000 contracts concluded per year, resolves disputes and pays out the network of offices and advisors. It keeps the consumer service free while proving to every partner that the demand it buys is qualified and documented.

primaryCustomers.name: Lender Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Receives complete, compliant credit files from the broker channel and reconciles referral commissions per concluded loan.

primaryCustomers.name: Insurer, Energy and Telecom Partner
primaryCustomers.description: Keeps its tariffs listed accurately, receives switch orders and reconciles leads, contracts and commissions without disputes.

primaryCustomers.name: Network and Compliance Operations Manager
primaryCustomers.description: Reconciles commissions from more than 50 partners and pays the office network correctly and on time.
